description: OMOP CDM v5.4 LOCATION table — a uniquely identified geographic location. The main purpose of the Location table is to represent the address information of Persons and Care Sites.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each geographic location.

fields.label: Address 1
fields.description: The address field 1, typically used for the street address, as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Address 2
fields.description: The address field 2, typically used for additional detail such as building, suite, floor, as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: City
fields.description: The city field as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: State
fields.description: The state field as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: County
fields.description: The county as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Country
fields.description: The country as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Location Source Value
fields.description: The verbatim information that is used to uniquely identify the location as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: The geocoded latitude of the location.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: The geocoded longitude of the location.
